simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ (H5885) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ (ʻÊyn Shemesh) means En-Shemesh , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 7.

definitions.full: H5885. En Shemesh שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ עֵין proper name, of a location on border between Judah Josh 15:7 ( πηγῆς ἡλίου ) and Benjamin 18:17 ( πηγὴν βαιθσαμυς , ᵐ5 L [πη]γὴν Σαμες ); conjectures in Buhl Geogr. 98 .
definitions.rootNote: from 5869 and 8121 ; fountain of the sun ;
